text.tspan: NestHub • Member-facing functions in the current source • Each oval has its own UC_ID
Dashed arrows: optional actions extend inspection at the stated condition. Solid lines: actor participation, not execution order.
Scope: ordinary USER account. Host management and approved service-provider operations belong to their respective role/capability diagrams.
Public browsing is also available to guests. Registration precedes membership. No payment, accommodation-review submission or support-ticket flow is implied. Source: 25 November 2026.
